summary: Ran the molecular tests for M1-S01 (object-model, agent metadata-builder) of build northwind-sales at scale project. Both always-on checks (xml over 8 files, manifest against package.xml) passed, and all three plan-declared checkers (check_opportunity_management.py, check_picklist_and_value_sets.py, check_object_creation_and_design.py) exited 0 with the exact messages their step-note fixtures predicted. check-outputs confirmed all 9 declared outputs present, non-empty and parseable. The two declared manual tests are deferred verbatim to the M1 milestone gate. Step moved built -> tested.
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran or was correctly classified as manual, both always-on checks completed, and every result came from an exit code this agent observed directly (step-tester AGENT.md Step 7).

process_observations.observation: package.xml under artefacts/M1-S01/ names exactly the 7 members the step's outputs produce, one <name> block per type, matching the manifest test's description verbatim.

All three cited-skill checkers passed clean on the first run in this session, reproducing the exact output strings recorded in the step's acceptance_tests[].description, which increases confidence those descriptions were written against a real fixture rather than an assumed one.

deploy-order.md section 0 does lead with the sf project retrieve start / merge instruction for StandardValueSet:OpportunityStage and states the deactivation risk in the same paragraph, and the literal string 'Commit' does not appear anywhere in OpportunityStage.standardValueSet-meta.xml (grep exit 1) -- both read consistently with what the two manual tests claim, though this agent does not tick them.

The manifest and manual acceptance test for this step both hinge on D1/A24 -- a retrieve-and-merge that this design-only build cannot perform itself -- so the shipped package.xml and standardValueSet file are internally consistent with each other but are not yet consistent with the target org's existing OpportunityStage values; that gap is exactly what the deferred manual tests exist to catch at the milestone gate, not something this run can close.
M1-S01 is now tested; the next stage the build layer defines is documentation for this step before the M1 milestone can be verified.
process_observations.followup_reason: because PLAN.md, the workbook rows, decisions.md and traceability.md for M1-S01 still need to be written now that the step is tested.
